notes:
I don't have any notes on Psalm 60 for you yet. None of my attempts to read the source pages worked.

My first attempt to fetch the pages crashed because of a bug in my own code. When I tried again, the tool said I had used up my code runs for this turn. That tool is the only way I can search or open web pages, so I didn't read a single source.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes from memory. Without a page behind each point, they would be unsourced.

**Next step:** ask me again (for example, "continue") and I'll start with these pages:
- Enduring Word: enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-60/
- Bible Hub, which has Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and others for each verse: biblehub.com/commentaries/psalms/60-1.htm through 60-12.htm
- StudyLight, Gill's Exposition: studylight.org/commentaries/eng/geb/psalms-60.html
- NET Bible notes for modern scholarship: netbible.org/bible/Psalms+60
- New Advent, Augustine on this psalm. Augustine numbers the Psalms differently, so he treats it as Psalm 59.
- Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (via spurgeon.org or ccel.org), Precept Austin and Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu) to compare traditions.

I'd then write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after every point, and leave out anything I can't find.
